requirements.quote:
Error handling in TLS is very simple.  When an error is detected, the
   detecting party sends a message to its peer.  Upon transmission or
   receipt of a fatal alert message, both parties MUST immediately close
   the connection.
requirements.condition: a fatal alert is transmitted
requirements.required_behavior: immediately close the connection
requirements.why_checkable: Connection state after alert transmission is directly observable.

requirements.quote:
Error handling in TLS is very simple.  When an error is detected, the

requirements.condition: a fatal alert is received
requirements.required_behavior: immediately close the connection
requirements.why_checkable: Connection state after alert receipt is directly observable.

requirements.quote:
unexpected_message:  An inappropriate message (e.g., the wrong
      handshake message, premature Application Data, etc.) was received.
      This alert should never be observed in communication between
      proper implementations.
requirements.condition: an inappropriate message is received, such as a wrong handshake message or premature Application Data
requirements.required_behavior: use unexpected_message to report the error
requirements.why_checkable: Message sequencing tests can verify the selected alert description.

requirements.quote:
bad_record_mac:  This alert is returned if a record is received which
      cannot be deprotected.  Because AEAD algorithms combine decryption
      and verification, and also to avoid side-channel attacks, this
      alert is used for all deprotection failures.  This alert should
      never be observed in communication between proper implementations,
      except when messages were corrupted in the network.
requirements.condition: a received record cannot be deprotected for any reason
requirements.required_behavior: use bad_record_mac for the deprotection failure
requirements.why_checkable: Corrupt ciphertext and authentication failures can be tested for a uniform alert.

requirements.quote:
record_overflow:  A TLSCiphertext record was received that had a
      length more than 2^14 + 256 bytes, or a record decrypted to a
      TLSPlaintext record with more than 2^14 bytes (or some other
      negotiated limit).  This alert should never be observed in
      communication between proper implementations, except when messages
      were corrupted in the network.
requirements.condition: a received TLSCiphertext record is longer than 2^14 + 256 bytes
requirements.required_behavior: use record_overflow to report the error
requirements.why_checkable: The ciphertext length boundary can be tested directly.

requirements.quote:
record_overflow:  A TLSCiphertext record was received that had a
      length more than 2^14 + 256 bytes, or a record decrypted to a
      TLSPlaintext record with more than 2^14 bytes (or some other
      negotiated limit).  This alert should never be observed in
      communication between proper implementations, except when messages
      were corrupted in the network.
requirements.condition: a record decrypts to TLSPlaintext longer than 2^14 bytes or another negotiated limit
requirements.required_behavior: use record_overflow to report the error
requirements.why_checkable: The plaintext or negotiated length boundary can be tested directly.

requirements.quote:
handshake_failure:  Receipt of a "handshake_failure" alert message
      indicates that the sender was unable to negotiate an acceptable
      set of security parameters given the options available.
requirements.condition: handshake_failure is received
requirements.required_behavior: interpret it as the sender being unable to negotiate an acceptable security-parameter set
requirements.why_checkable: The alert can be mapped to a concrete negotiation failure for the caller.

requirements.quote:
bad_certificate:  A certificate was corrupt, contained signatures
      that did not verify correctly, etc.
requirements.condition: a received certificate is corrupt
requirements.required_behavior: use bad_certificate to report the error
requirements.why_checkable: A corrupt certificate fixture can verify alert selection.

requirements.quote:
bad_certificate:  A certificate was corrupt, contained signatures
      that did not verify correctly, etc.
requirements.condition: a received certificate contains a signature that does not verify
requirements.required_behavior: use bad_certificate to report the error
requirements.why_checkable: An invalid certificate signature fixture can verify alert selection.

requirements.quote: unsupported_certificate:  A certificate was of an unsupported type.
requirements.condition: a received certificate has an unsupported type
requirements.required_behavior: use unsupported_certificate to report the error
requirements.why_checkable: An unsupported certificate type can verify alert selection.

requirements.quote: certificate_revoked:  A certificate was revoked by its signer.
requirements.condition: a received certificate has been revoked by its signer
requirements.required_behavior: use certificate_revoked to report the error
requirements.why_checkable: A revoked certificate fixture can verify alert selection.

requirements.quote:
certificate_expired:  A certificate has expired or is not currently
      valid.
requirements.condition: a received certificate has expired
requirements.required_behavior: use certificate_expired to report the error
requirements.why_checkable: An expired certificate fixture can verify alert selection.

requirements.quote:
certificate_expired:  A certificate has expired or is not currently
      valid.
requirements.condition: a received certificate is not currently valid
requirements.required_behavior: use certificate_expired to report the error
requirements.why_checkable: A certificate outside its validity interval can verify alert selection.

requirements.quote:
certificate_unknown:  Some other (unspecified) issue arose in
      processing the certificate, rendering it unacceptable.
requirements.condition: another certificate-processing issue makes the certificate unacceptable
requirements.required_behavior: use certificate_unknown to report the error
requirements.why_checkable: A certificate rejection not covered by a more specific alert can verify the fallback mapping.

requirements.quote:
illegal_parameter:  A field in the handshake was incorrect or
      inconsistent with other fields.  This alert is used for errors
      which conform to the formal protocol syntax but are otherwise
      incorrect.
requirements.condition: a syntactically valid handshake field is incorrect
requirements.required_behavior: use illegal_parameter to report the error
requirements.why_checkable: A validly encoded incorrect field can verify semantic-error alert selection.

requirements.quote:
illegal_parameter:  A field in the handshake was incorrect or
      inconsistent with other fields.  This alert is used for errors
      which conform to the formal protocol syntax but are otherwise
      incorrect.
requirements.condition: a syntactically valid handshake field is inconsistent with another field
requirements.required_behavior: use illegal_parameter to report the error
requirements.why_checkable: Cross-field inconsistency can verify semantic-error alert selection.

requirements.quote:
unknown_ca:  A valid certificate chain or partial chain was received,
      but the certificate was not accepted because the CA certificate
      could not be located or could not be matched with a known trust
      anchor.
requirements.condition: a valid certificate chain or partial chain is rejected because the CA certificate cannot be located
requirements.required_behavior: use unknown_ca to report the error
requirements.why_checkable: Trust-store lookup failure can verify alert selection.

requirements.quote:
unknown_ca:  A valid certificate chain or partial chain was received,
      but the certificate was not accepted because the CA certificate
      could not be located or could not be matched with a known trust
      anchor.
requirements.condition: a valid certificate chain or partial chain is rejected because the CA certificate cannot be matched to a known trust anchor
requirements.required_behavior: use unknown_ca to report the error
requirements.why_checkable: Trust-anchor matching failure can verify alert selection.

requirements.quote:
access_denied:  A valid certificate or PSK was received, but when
      access control was applied, the sender decided not to proceed with
      negotiation.
requirements.condition: a valid certificate is rejected by access control
requirements.required_behavior: use access_denied to report the decision
requirements.why_checkable: Certificate-based access-control rejection can verify alert selection.

requirements.quote:
access_denied:  A valid certificate or PSK was received, but when
      access control was applied, the sender decided not to proceed with
      negotiation.
requirements.condition: a valid PSK is rejected by access control
requirements.required_behavior: use access_denied to report the decision
requirements.why_checkable: PSK-based access-control rejection can verify alert selection.

requirements.quote:
decode_error:  A message could not be decoded because some field was
      out of the specified range or the length of the message was
      incorrect.  This alert is used for errors where the message does
      not conform to the formal protocol syntax.  This alert should
      never be observed in communication between proper implementations,
      except when messages were corrupted in the network.
requirements.condition: a message field is outside its specified range
requirements.required_behavior: use decode_error to report the syntax failure
requirements.why_checkable: An out-of-range encoded field can verify syntax-error alert selection.

requirements.quote:
decode_error:  A message could not be decoded because some field was
      out of the specified range or the length of the message was
      incorrect.  This alert is used for errors where the message does
      not conform to the formal protocol syntax.  This alert should
      never be observed in communication between proper implementations,
      except when messages were corrupted in the network.
requirements.condition: a message has an incorrect encoded length
requirements.required_behavior: use decode_error to report the syntax failure
requirements.why_checkable: Malformed message lengths can verify syntax-error alert selection.

requirements.quote:
decrypt_error:  A handshake (not record layer) cryptographic
      operation failed, including being unable to correctly verify a
      signature or validate a Finished message or a PSK binder.
requirements.condition: a handshake-layer cryptographic operation fails, including signature, Finished, or PSK-binder validation
requirements.required_behavior: use decrypt_error to report the failure
requirements.why_checkable: Each handshake cryptographic verification path can be forced to fail and its alert inspected.

requirements.quote:
protocol_version:  The protocol version the peer has attempted to
      negotiate is recognized but not supported (see Appendix D).
requirements.condition: the peer attempts to negotiate a recognized but unsupported protocol version
requirements.required_behavior: use protocol_version to report the error
requirements.why_checkable: A supported_versions offer can exercise the recognized-but-disabled branch.

requirements.quote:
insufficient_security:  Returned instead of "handshake_failure" when
      a negotiation has failed specifically because the server requires
      parameters more secure than those supported by the client.
requirements.condition: negotiation fails specifically because the server requires stronger parameters than the client supports
requirements.required_behavior: use insufficient_security instead of handshake_failure
requirements.forbidden_behavior: use handshake_failure for this specific cause
requirements.why_checkable: Negotiation policy can force this precise alert-selection branch.

requirements.quote:
internal_error:  An internal error unrelated to the peer or the
      correctness of the protocol (such as a memory allocation failure)
      makes it impossible to continue.
requirements.condition: an internal error unrelated to the peer or protocol correctness makes continuation impossible
requirements.required_behavior: use internal_error to report the failure
requirements.why_checkable: Injected internal failures can verify the alert mapping.

requirements.quote:
inappropriate_fallback:  Sent by a server in response to an invalid
      connection retry attempt from a client (see [RFC7507]).
requirements.condition: a server receives an invalid client connection-retry attempt
requirements.required_behavior: use inappropriate_fallback to report the error
requirements.why_checkable: An invalid fallback retry can verify server alert selection.

requirements.quote:
missing_extension:  Sent by endpoints that receive a handshake
      message not containing an extension that is mandatory to send for
      the offered TLS version or other negotiated parameters.
requirements.condition: a received handshake message omits an extension mandatory for the offered version or negotiated parameters
requirements.required_behavior: use missing_extension to report the error
requirements.why_checkable: A handshake fixture can omit the required extension and expose the selected alert.

requirements.quote:
unsupported_extension:  Sent by endpoints receiving any handshake
      message containing an extension known to be prohibited for
      inclusion in the given handshake message, or including any
      extensions in a ServerHello or Certificate not first offered in
      the corresponding ClientHello or CertificateRequest.
requirements.condition: a handshake message contains an extension prohibited in that message
requirements.required_behavior: use unsupported_extension to report the error
requirements.why_checkable: A known extension can be inserted into a prohibited message and the alert inspected.

requirements.quote:
unsupported_extension:  Sent by endpoints receiving any handshake
      message containing an extension known to be prohibited for
      inclusion in the given handshake message, or including any
      extensions in a ServerHello or Certificate not first offered in
      the corresponding ClientHello or CertificateRequest.
requirements.condition: ServerHello contains an extension not offered in the corresponding ClientHello
requirements.required_behavior: use unsupported_extension to report the error
requirements.why_checkable: Cross-message extension-offer consistency can be tested.

requirements.quote:
unsupported_extension:  Sent by endpoints receiving any handshake
      message containing an extension known to be prohibited for
      inclusion in the given handshake message, or including any
      extensions in a ServerHello or Certificate not first offered in
      the corresponding ClientHello or CertificateRequest.
requirements.condition: Certificate contains an extension not offered in the corresponding CertificateRequest
requirements.required_behavior: use unsupported_extension to report the error
requirements.why_checkable: Cross-message extension-offer consistency can be tested.

requirements.quote:
unrecognized_name:  Sent by servers when no server exists identified
      by the name provided by the client via the "server_name" extension
      (see [RFC6066]).
requirements.condition: a server has no server identified by the client's server_name extension
requirements.required_behavior: use unrecognized_name to report the condition
requirements.why_checkable: An unmatched SNI value can verify server alert selection.

requirements.quote:
bad_certificate_status_response:  Sent by clients when an invalid or
      unacceptable OCSP response is provided by the server via the
      "status_request" extension (see [RFC6066]).
requirements.condition: a client receives an invalid or unacceptable OCSP response in the server's status_request extension
requirements.required_behavior: use bad_certificate_status_response to report the error
requirements.why_checkable: An invalid stapled OCSP response can verify client alert selection.
